The culmination of my life’s work.

Why are great stories so engaging—and compelling? Why are we all so insistent on proclaiming and protecting  our fundamental beliefs? Why are we so dreadfully willing to die—or kill—for a cause? 

What makes for depth and greatness in literature? How are we to understand the profound? The religious?

Our first and only 12-hour offering—Dr Jordan B. Peterson's Maps of Meaning—provides the deepest of answers to all of these impossible questions. Updated, broaden
